Visuals
Scene 1: A wide, cinematic tracking shot of a sun-drenched city street. @Image2 walks through the bustling crowd, her shoulders slightly hunched. The camera zooms in for a tight close-up on her midsection as it visibly trembles with a sharp contraction.

Scene 2: @Image2 stops in front of a large glass window with "BAKES" written in gold lettering. The camera captures her reflection in the glass as she gazes at a tiered display of golden-brown loaves and frosted pastries. She wears the "happy/wide-eyed" expression from her reference sheet, a faint, longing smile touching her lips.

Scene 3: The camera follows @Image2 as she moves to the side of the entrance and slides down against the wall to a seated position,  She tucks her legs in and waits.

Scene 4: A series of quick cuts show the blurry legs and polished shoes of adults walking past her. Every time a pair of feet slows down, @Image2 looks up with the "hopeful" expression from her sheet, offering a small, polite smile. The adults look straight ahead or at their phones, completely ignoring her. Her smile slowly falters into the "neutral/weary" pose.

Scene 5: The camera angle shifts to an eye-level shot looking down the sidewalk. @Image1 enters the frame, walking with a rhythmic, upbeat bounce. He is completely immersed in his own world, wearing his headphones and displaying the "happy/singing along" expression from his reference sheet. He is the only person on the street moving with a sense of joy, oblivious to the heat or the crowds.

Audio & Dialogue
Ambience: The heavy, layered roar of city life: distant sirens, the rhythmic thud-thud of tires over manhole covers, and the collective murmur of a hundred conversations.

Foley: A distinct, low-frequency "growl" sound of an empty stomach, followed by the light tinkle of a bell every time the bakery door opens, releasing the muffled sound of classical music from inside.

Character Audio: As @Image1 approaches, the audio world shifts. The city noise dampens, and a tinny, upbeat lo-fi hip-hop track begins to leak from his headphones. He is humming a few notes under his breath, a sharp contrast to the silence of @Image2.

Visuales  
Escena 1: Una toma panorámica y cinematográfica de una calle de la ciudad bañada por el sol. @Image2 camina entre la multitud bulliciosa, con los hombros ligeramente encorvados. La cámara hace un zoom para un primer plano ajustado en su torso mientras tiembla visiblemente con una fuerte contracción.

Escena 2: @Image2 se detiene frente a una gran ventana de vidrio con "BAKES" escrito en letras doradas. La cámara captura su reflejo en el vidrio mientras observa una exhibición escalonada de panes dorados y pasteles glaseados. Lleva la expresión "feliz/con los ojos abiertos" de su hoja de referencia, una leve sonrisa de anhelo toca sus labios.

Escena 3: La cámara sigue a @Image2 mientras se mueve hacia el lado de la entrada y se desliza contra la pared hasta quedar sentada. Recoge sus piernas y espera.

Escena 4: Una serie de cortes rápidos muestran las piernas borrosas y los zapatos pulidos de adultos que pasan junto a ella. Cada vez que un par de pies se detiene, @Image2 mira hacia arriba con la expresión "esperanzada" de su hoja, ofreciendo una pequeña y educada sonrisa. Los adultos miran al frente o a sus teléfonos, ignorándola por completo. Su sonrisa se desvanece lentamente en la pose "neutral/cansada".

Escena 5: El ángulo de la cámara cambia a una toma a nivel de los ojos mirando por la acera. @Image1 entra en el encuadre, caminando con un ritmo alegre y animado. Está completamente inmerso en su propio mundo, usando sus auriculares y mostrando la expresión "feliz/cantando" de su hoja de referencia. Es la única persona en la calle que se mueve con un sentido de alegría, ajeno al calor o a la multitud.

Audio y Diálogo  
Ambiente: El rugido pesado y estratificado de la vida urbana: sirenas distantes, el ritmo sordo de los neumáticos sobre las tapas de alcantarilla y el murmullo colectivo de cien conversaciones.

Foley: Un sonido "gruñido" distintivo y de baja frecuencia de un estómago vacío, seguido del ligero tintineo de una campana cada vez que se abre la puerta de la panadería, liberando el sonido amortiguado de música clásica desde dentro.

Audio de Personajes: A medida que @Image1 se acerca, el mundo de audio cambia. El ruido de la ciudad se amortigua y una pista de lo-fi hip-hop alegre y metálica comienza a filtrarse de sus auriculares. Tararea algunas notas bajo su aliento, un fuerte contraste con el silencio de @Image2.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---  
[Hilo 1] 1⃣ 

Necesitarás hacer un prompt de los dos personajes que necesitas.

"Make a character sheet of this child. This has to be in Disney artstyle. Show her various expressions, from behind, from the front and from the side. The child is an orphan, wearing raggy clothes. No text. White background."

Make a character sheet of this male child. He is a pre-teen male. He wears jacket and jeans, wearing headphones to show that he is hip. Show his various expressions, from behind, from the front and from the side. No text. White background. This has to be in Disney artstyle."

[Hilo 2] 2⃣ 

A continuación, usa GPT Image 2 y Nanobanana. Usa los personajes que creaste y súbelos como referencia. Luego usa el siguiente prompt.

"Create a storyboard of these characters with the following info. "The sun was too bright for a stomach so empty. Elara sat against the soot-stained brick of the bakery, her small hand extended. She didn’t beg with a snarl or a demand; she asked with eyes that still somehow believed in the goodness of the people rushing past." Please," she whispered to a boy wearing the headphones. "Just a little something?" Leo let out a heavy, dramatic sigh. He was running late, his headphones were tangled, and the heat was making his collar itch. He looked at the girl... really looked at her... and felt a sharp, uncomfortable prick of guilt that only made him more irritated. "I don't have any cash," he snapped, digging into his pocket. He pulled out a slightly squashed chocolate bar and shoved it toward her. "Here. Just... stop asking, okay?" He didn't wait for a thank you. He marched off, his face twisted in a scowl of lingering annoyance. Elara looked down at the crumpled silver wrapper. Her heart sank, not because of the meager offering, but because of the way he’d looked at her, like she was a stain on a sidewalk he was trying to keep clean. She tucked the chocolate into her pocket, her eyes stinging more than her hunger. The boy sighs, looks back at the girl, goes inside the bakery, buys some sweets for her, and gives her a few dollars. Says that's all he has and he hopes she will be okay. The girl hugs her, which embarrasses him."

---
ビジュアル

シーン1: 日差しが降り注ぐ街の通りを広く、シネマティックなトラッキングショットで撮影。@Image2が賑やかな人混みの中を歩き、肩を少しすぼめている。カメラは彼女の胴体にズームインし、鋭い収縮で震えている様子をクローズアップで捉える。

シーン2: @Image2は「BAKES」と金色の文字で書かれた大きなガラス窓の前で立ち止まる。カメラは彼女が金色に輝くパンとフロストされたペストリーの段々としたディスプレイを見つめる様子をガラスに映し出す。彼女はリファレンスシートの「幸せ/目を見開いた」表情をし、唇にかすかな、切ない微笑みを浮かべている。

シーン3: カメラは@Image2を追い、彼女が入口の横に移動し、壁に寄りかかって座る様子を捉える。彼女は足を引き寄せ、待っている。

シーン4: 大人たちが彼女の前を通り過ぎる様子を、ぼやけた足と磨かれた靴のクイックカットで見せる。足が止まるたびに、@Image2はリファレンスシートの「希望に満ちた」表情で見上げ、小さく礼儀正しい微笑みを浮かべる。大人たちは彼女を完全に無視し、まっすぐ前を見たり携帯を見たりしている。彼女の微笑みはゆっくりと「中立/疲れた」ポーズに変わる。

シーン5: カメラアングルが歩道を見下ろす目線のショットに変わる。@Image1がフレームに入り、リズミカルで陽気なステップで歩いている。彼はヘッドフォンをつけ、自分の世界に没頭しており、リファレンスシートの「幸せ/歌に合わせて歌う」表情を見せている。彼は通りで唯一、暑さや人混みを気にせずに喜びを持って動いている人である。

オーディオとダイアログ

アンビエンス: 都会の生活の重層的な轟音: 遠くのサイレン、マンホールカバーを越えるタイヤのリズミカルな音、百の会話の集団的なざわめき。

フォーリー: 空腹の胃の低周波「うなり」音に続いて、パン屋のドアが開くたびに軽やかなベルの音が鳴り、内部からクラシック音楽のこもった音が流れる。

キャラクターオーディオ: @Image1が近づくと、オーディオの世界が変わる。街の騒音が和らぎ、彼のヘッドフォンから陽気なローファイヒップホップのトラックが漏れ始める。彼は小声でいくつかの音をハミングしており、@Image2の静けさとは対照的である。

He pulled out a slightly squashed chocolate bar and shoved it toward her. "Here. Just... stop asking, okay?" He didn't wait for a thank you. He marched off, his face twisted in a scowl of lingering annoyance. Elara looked down at the crumpled silver wrapper. Her heart sank, not because of the meager offering, but because of the way he’d looked at her, like she was a stain on a sidewalk he was trying to keep clean. She tucked the chocolate into her pocket, her eyes stinging more than her hunger. The boy sighs, looks back at the girl, goes inside the bakery, buys some sweets for her, and gives her a few dollars.
